title: Blood glucose levels appear irregularly every 5 or 10 minutes
body: I am using Samsung Galaxy S10e and updated the software to Android 10 a few days ago. I haven't read blood glucose since then, but I changed the settings and changed the xdrip version to the date of 20191222 and it's working now. However, blood glucose measurement is operated irregularly every 5 or 10 minutes. Before updating the Android version, it was measured every 5 minutes without any problem.I am wondering if this is an xdrip problem or an issue due to the Android version. Or can the problem be solved by changing the settings?

comments.body:
Hey Yang. I had the same problem on my Galaxy Fold. 

In less common options/other misc settings - You need to turn on Samsung Workarounds. In less common options - Bluetooth settings - check Bluetooth Watchdog and G5 Bluetooth Watchdog. Uncheck Close GATT on BLE disconnect. 

This made the 5 minute readings return correctly.
@opasha is xdrip still working for you without issue? Are you using a Dexcom G6?

Please check out my website that I made for this exact reasons and let my know what you think [https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1236](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1236) =)
